feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Rep. Thomas Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war
entry.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie has moved to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The Kentucky Republican alleges that Hegseth has waged the Iran war illegally, among other "high crimes and misdemeanors."

entry.title: Vanity Fair feature profiles the political development of JD Vance at Yale
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel talks with journalist Chris Whipple about his new Vanity Fair feature with revealing details about the political development of JD Vance.

entry.title: As campaign season gears up, AI-generated ads are everywhere
entry.summary: Data suggests many candidates are embracing AI this year to boost their image and portray their opponents unfavorably. But whether it will turn out voters remains unclear.

entry.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
entry.summary: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.

entry.title: For many Pennsylvania Democrats, frustration with Fetterman is at a breaking point
entry.summary: A group of former campaign and Senate staffers for John Fetterman say they will soon begin dropping damaging stories about the Pennsylvania Democrat. Many of his constituents are already fed up.

entry.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close it, as judge again keeps Trump's name off
entry.summary: The board's vote to shutter the historic arts center came amid concerns about financial, structural problems.

entry.title: Republican Rep. Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war
entry.summary: Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Tuesday over the war in Iran.

entry.title: Trump says developing AI is a critical race, downplaying fears
entry.summary: President Trump continues to support frontier artificial intelligence development, despite industry fears such technology could destroy humanity, casting AI as a critical race against China.

entry.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders says Congress has gotten a 'wake-up call' on AI risks
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders,I-Vermont, about his concerns over the risks of artificial intelligence.

entry.title: A Trump-backed crypto bill just suffered a bruising defeat in the Senate. Here's why
entry.summary: The legislation was intended to establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time. But it suffered a stinging defeat in the Senate on Tuesday.
